V. Valentine

They gave you to me
centuries ago,
and I think they were thinking
of you.

Of someone whose name alone
rearranges the furniture
inside a chest.

VI. Always, Already

I did not fall for you.
Falling implies
it was sudden,
implies I didn't mean to.

I walked toward you,
slowly, deliberately,
with my whole heart open
and my eyes clear.
